# QCT Commerce

> QCT Commerce builds multilingual digital commerce, B2B sales and automation systems for companies growing in Türkiye and selected international markets.

QCT Commerce provides e-commerce architecture, multilingual websites, B2B catalogues, conversion-focused landing pages, SEO, GEO, AEO, AIO, CRM integration, WhatsApp sales systems and AI-supported business automation.

The primary market is Türkiye. International market entry pages are currently available in English and Georgian for companies in Georgia entering Türkiye, Europe and Gulf markets.

QCT Commerce is part of the [QCT Studio](https://qctstudio.com/) network.

Verified contact information: info@qctcommerce.com; telephone and WhatsApp: +90 543 385 66 56.

## International pages

- [International home](https://qctcommerce.com/en/): Digital commerce and international sales systems for manufacturers, distributors and growing brands.
- [English selected work](https://qctcommerce.com/en/work/): Verified live projects across multilingual e-commerce, corporate B2B websites and service architecture.
- [English e-commerce systems](https://qctcommerce.com/en/ecommerce/): Product discovery, checkout, measurement and commerce operations.
- [English B2B web design](https://qctcommerce.com/en/web-design/): Multilingual B2B websites structured around buyer questions and conversion paths.
- [English search visibility](https://qctcommerce.com/en/search-visibility/): Technical SEO, GEO, AEO and AIO foundations for search and AI-assisted research.
- [English AI and sales automation](https://qctcommerce.com/en/ai-automation/): Controlled CRM, lead routing and AI-assisted operational workflows.
- [Georgia market page in English](https://qctcommerce.com/en/georgia/): Multilingual B2B websites, export catalogues, SEO, GEO and sales automation for Georgian companies.
- [Georgia market page in Georgian](https://qctcommerce.com/ka/georgia/): ქართული კომპანიებისთვის მრავალენოვანი B2B ვებსაიტები, საექსპორტო კატალოგები და გაყიდვების ავტომატიზაცია.

## Services

- [E-ticaret altyapısı](https://qctcommerce.com/e-ticaret/): Product discovery, cart, checkout and store operations planned as one system.
- [Web tasarımı](https://qctcommerce.com/web-tasarim/): Corporate websites aligned with commercial goals and user needs.
- [WhatsApp satış sistemleri](https://qctcommerce.com/whatsapp-satis/): Messaging, lead handling and customer follow-up systems.
- [SEO, GEO, AEO ve AIO](https://qctcommerce.com/seo-geo/): Search-engine, geographic, answer-engine and AI visibility foundations.
- [Meta reklamları](https://qctcommerce.com/meta-reklamlari/): Meta campaigns and conversion-focused landing pages.
- [Yapay zekâ otomasyonları](https://qctcommerce.com/yapay-zeka-otomasyonlari/): Workflow automation for repeated business operations.
